description: Agent Claims: submit a sworn proof of loss with the first notice of loss and the policy: the proof with its reference, the claim number and policy number it cites, the currency, the total it claims, each item it claims with its id, the item and the amount, whether it is signed, whether it is sworn or notarized, the day signed, the day the insurer asked for it and the day it was filed; the first notice with its claim number, the day of the loss, the day notice was given, the currency, the amount of loss the intake record shows and each item it reported; the policy with its number, the days it allows to file a proof of loss and whether they count from the loss, the notice or the insurer’s request. The signed report gives the proof, the first notice and the policy, the amount claimed against the intake record with the items totalled, each item claimed paired with the items first reported and every item never reported named, the signature and the oath, and the filing day against the proof-of-loss deadline with the days late, and counts them, and names a divergent proof of loss: a claimed amount unlike the intake record or in another currency, an item the first notice never reported, an unsigned proof, an unsworn proof and filing after the policy’s proof-of-loss deadline; then a claimed amount unlike its own items and another claim or policy number, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No amount on either record, no record of the signature or oath, no proof-of-loss period or the day it counts from, or no filing day where a deadline is set leaves the proof unverified. Amounts compare to the cent in one currency, items read by their words with plurals folded, and the deadline counts in whole days. This reads the proof of loss as filed against the intake record and the policy. Verdict claims_proof_of_loss_divergent, claims_proof_of_loss_partial, claims_proof_of_loss_unverified or claims_proof_of_loss_consistent. POST /api/claims-proof-of-loss-check. Reads the claim records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between claim documents only: it never files or submits a claim, never negotiates or pays one and never decides coverage, which stays with the insurer, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Claims reads claim records across the claim lifecycle for consistency between the claim documents and the policy they claim under: a first notice of loss, a sworn proof of loss, an adjuster’s report, a repair or replacement estimate, a settlement offer and release, a denial letter, a subrogation demand and a claim payment record, each against the policy, the first notice, the inspection record and claim file, the approved scope, the claim valuation, the claim record, the payment record or the settlement or adjudication it should agree with. The family is sector-neutral across property, casualty and liability claims and reads different claim documents against each other and against the policy. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-claims-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-claims/.
